notes.title: Version 0.2.3: UI fixes, typo fixes
notes.content:
- Fixed typos in the manual and stories
- Fixed display of the manual in low resolutions (the text overlapped the scroll on the right, the text itself took up less space than the list of elements)
- Fixed the behavior of the mouse cursor, which sometimes changed to a standard arrow when moving along the buttons

notes.title: Updating the demo version to 0.2.1
notes.content: Fixed minor typos in dialogs. Thanks to everyone who writes about them to my email, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3685900/discussions/0/598526260522535808/]in the community[/url], in the group and other places!
